meta.about: Generic, brand-free healthier swaps by product category, suited to Indian kitchens and shops. Brand alternatives come from the product database and Open Food Facts, not from this file.

swaps.name: Whole-wheat or millet noodles, cooked with half the tastemaker
swaps.why: More fibre; using half the seasoning packet roughly halves the salt.

swaps.name: Vegetable poha or upma
swaps.why: Quick to make, far less salt and no added flavour enhancers.

swaps.name: Vermicelli (seviyan) upma with vegetables
swaps.why: Same comfort, you control the salt and oil.

swaps.name: Roasted makhana (fox nuts) with light seasoning
swaps.why: Crunchy, low in fat when dry-roasted, and you control the salt.

swaps.name: Roasted chana or peanuts (unsalted or lightly salted)
swaps.why: Protein and fibre keep you full; no frying oil.

swaps.name: Cucumber, carrot or fruit chaat
swaps.why: Fibre and water, with only a pinch of chaat masala.

swaps.name: A handful of nuts and a fruit
swaps.why: Healthy fats and fibre instead of refined flour, sugar and palm oil.

swaps.name: Homemade besan or oats chilla
swaps.why: Protein-rich and filling for tea time.

swaps.name: Biscuits made with whole wheat or millets and no hydrogenated fat
swaps.why: If you want a biscuit, check for whole grain as the first ingredient and no 'hydrogenated' or 'vanaspati'.

swaps.name: Dark chocolate (70% cocoa or more), a small piece
swaps.why: Less sugar per bite and fewer additives.

swaps.name: Dates, figs or a few raisins
swaps.why: Sweet, with fibre and minerals.

swaps.name: Fresh seasonal fruit
swaps.why: Natural sugar comes packaged with fibre and water.

swaps.name: Nimbu pani with little or no sugar
swaps.why: Refreshing, with a fraction of the sugar.

swaps.name: Plain or masala chaas (buttermilk)
swaps.why: Cooling, low in sugar, with some protein and probiotics.

swaps.name: Plain sparkling water with lemon
swaps.why: Keeps the fizz, drops the sugar and phosphoric acid.

swaps.name: Whole fresh fruit
swaps.why: Same sweetness with the fibre left in, so sugar is absorbed more slowly.

swaps.name: Tender coconut water
swaps.why: Naturally hydrating and lower in sugar than most packaged juices.

swaps.name: Water, plus a short walk or rest
swaps.why: Tiredness is often dehydration or poor sleep.

swaps.name: A cup of tea or coffee with little sugar (adults only)
swaps.why: Much less caffeine and sugar than most energy drinks.

swaps.name: Plain rolled oats or dalia cooked with milk and fruit
swaps.why: Whole grain, no added sugar unless you add it.

swaps.name: Vegetable poha, upma, idli or besan chilla
swaps.why: Traditional breakfasts with more protein or fibre and less sugar.

swaps.name: Plain milk with a pinch of cardamom or haldi
swaps.why: Protein and calcium without the added sugar many of these powders contain.

swaps.name: Ragi malt made at home with little jaggery
swaps.why: Calcium-rich millet; you control the sweetness.

swaps.name: Plain milk or unsweetened lassi with fruit
swaps.why: Same protein and calcium, much less added sugar.

swaps.name: Plain dahi with chopped fruit
swaps.why: Probiotics and protein without added sugar or thickeners.

swaps.name: Frozen banana or mango 'nice cream'
swaps.why: Creamy, with fruit sugar and fibre instead of vegetable fat and syrup.

swaps.name: A real dairy ice cream, small portion
swaps.why: 'Frozen dessert' often uses vegetable fat in place of milk fat; check the label.

swaps.name: Bread with whole wheat or multigrain listed first and 3 g+ fibre per 100 g
swaps.why: Many 'brown' breads are mostly maida; the first ingredient tells you.

swaps.name: Fresh roti or paratha made from atta
swaps.why: Whole grain with no preservatives.

swaps.name: Fresh green chutney (mint-coriander) or tomato chutney made at home
swaps.why: Far less sugar and salt, no preservatives.

swaps.name: Hung curd dip
swaps.why: Creamy like mayonnaise, with protein and much less fat.

swaps.name: Khichdi, dal-rice or a simple sabzi-roti
swaps.why: Takes 20-30 minutes, much less salt, and no preservatives.

swaps.name: Fresh chicken, fish, eggs, paneer or dal
swaps.why: Protein without nitrite preservatives (processed meat is an IARC Group 1 carcinogen).

swaps.name: Dates-and-nuts ladoo, small portion
swaps.why: Sweetness with fibre and healthy fats.

swaps.name: Fresh fruit
swaps.why: Satisfies a sweet craving with far less sugar.

swaps.name: Rotate mustard, groundnut, rice-bran or sesame oil
swaps.why: A mix of oils balances fats; avoid vanaspati and other hydrogenated fats.

swaps.name: A version with fewer ingredients you recognise
swaps.why: Shorter ingredient lists usually mean less processing.

swaps.name: Fresh or home-cooked food when possible
swaps.why: You control salt, sugar and oil.
